req.title: Reject limit above cap
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the limit parameter exceeds the maximum allowed.

doc.reasoning: The endpoint GET /tasks/ declares limit with Query(100, ge=1, le=1000). Any value > 1000 must yield HTTP 422. We need: (1) a positive case confirming a valid limit works (EP), (2) a negative case with a clearly over-cap value (NEG), (3) boundary cases at exactly 1000 (max allowed, BVA), 1001 (first rejected, BVA), and 999 (one below cap, BVA). We also test limit=1 (minimum boundary, BVA). The previously failing test[7] had kind=negative but heuristic=EP — a logical contradiction since EP partitions for negative tests must use NEG heuristic. Fixed by changing heuristic to NEG for that test. All other tests are preserved unchanged.

expected: Response body is a JSON array
trace: R-TASK-007 — valid limit partition must succeed

assert r.status_code == 200
body = r.json()
assert isinstance(body, list)

tests.name: test_limit_one_above_cap_1001_returns_422

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

r = client.get("/tasks/?limit=1001")
assert r.status_code == 422
body = r.json()
assert "detail" in body
errors = body["detail"]
assert isinstance(errors, list)
assert len(errors) >= 1
locs = [e.get("loc") for e in errors]
assert any("limit" in loc for loc in locs)
